name: Create a layout from a current Part

steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-layout-candidate.opj` as its active project
a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-creation-layout-candidate/English/layout-data/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is active

the drawing browser lists a parts list and a view referencing the component
